WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    si.riskeval,
    AVG(s.pressratio) as avg_pressratio,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.zoneref,
  step1.riskeval,
  step1.avg_pressratio,
  step1.record_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN step2.total_count IS NOT NULL 
    THEN CAST(step1.record_count AS REAL) / step2.total_count 
    ELSE NULL 
  END as ratio
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
